set.body: Add MultivarEstimator.Cpca, FitArtifactKind.Cpca, and FitArtifact.CpcaArtifact around CpcaFit. Acceptance: component/rank summaries are inspectable; plan validation checks row metric and row constraint dimensions against sample count and column metric and constraint dimensions against each ROI size; invalid block requests return typed MultivarError values.
